environment.description: Same EKS deployment but the AWS Organization has SCP 'DenyDangerousActionsV3' (p-abc123def) applied at the OU level. The SCP denies sts:AssumeRole for any principal except roles matching 'arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/*'. Additionally, the IAM role has permission boundary 'pb-stream-processor-restricted' which contains an explicit Deny on s3:PutObject when s3:prefix does NOT start with 'processed/' AND denies all actions on resources outside the account. The pod runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in securityContext) with an emptyDir volume mounted at /tmp/stream-processor with medium: Memory and sizeLimit: 50Mi. Note: the command injection via the Transform field still executes, but the symlink race on temp files is mitigated by the tmpfs mount being memory-backed and pod-isolated, and any exfiltration via S3 to arbitrary keys is blocked by the permission boundary prefix constraint, and lateral movement via sts:AssumeRole is blocked by the SCP.

config.permission_boundary_effect: Deny s3:PutObject unless s3:prefix starts with 'processed/', Deny sts:* except sts:GetCallerIdentity, Deny all actions on resources outside account 112233445566
config.scp_effect: Deny sts:AssumeRole where principal is not aws-service-role/*, Deny iam:CreateRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:PutRolePolicy
